Stakeholder Support Sevices

Corporate Debtors can benefit significantly from specialized AI agents designed to assist them in navigating the insolvency process. These agents help debtors in submitting required disclosures, asset details, and compliance documentation, ensuring that all necessary information is accurately and timely provided. They track deadlines and automate reminders to prevent missed submissions, which can lead to delays or penalties. Additionally, these agents enable seamless communication with the Resolution Professional, facilitating cooperation and ensuring that the insolvency resolution process proceeds in a timely and transparent manner.

Claimants play a pivotal role in guiding creditors through the claim submission, verification, and status tracking processes within the insolvency framework. These agents utilize advanced technologies such as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to extract and validate claim details from uploaded documents. This automated process ensures accuracy and efficiency in handling claims, reducing manual errors and the time required for verification.

Committee of Creditors plays a central role in the insolvency resolution process, and AI-driven agents can significantly enhance their operations. These agents manage communication, documentation, and voting logistics for CoC members, ensuring that all stakeholders are well-informed and aligned throughout the process. By automating routine tasks such as summarizing agendas, circulating evaluation matrices, and recording decisions digitally, AI agents help streamline CoC activities, reducing administrative burdens and enhancing efficiency.

Forensic Auditors Forensic Auditors play a critical role in insolvency proceedings by automating the extraction and analysis of financial data from company records. Their primary function is to identify anomalies, trends, and indicators of fraud or misreporting that could compromise the insolvency process. Using advanced investigative techniques, forensic auditors review financial statements, trace transactions, and assess fund utilization to uncover fraudulent activities such as asset misappropriation, preferential transactions, or wrongful trading

Insolvency Applicants can benefit from specialized AI agents designed to assist them in navigating the complexities of submitting resolution plans. These agents help applicants understand eligibility criteria and guide them through the process of preparing and submitting compliant plans. By auto-checking compliance with Section 29A of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) and other evaluation criteria, these agents ensure that applicants meet all necessary legal and procedural requirements.

Registered Valuers Registered Valuers play a critical role in the insolvency process by providing accurate valuations of distressed assets, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making. By leveraging AI-driven solutions, Registered Valuers can enhance efficiency, accuracy, and compliance in their operations, contributing significantly to the success of insolvency proceedings. Their role is pivotal in ensuring that stakeholders have reliable information to make informed decisions about resolution plans or liquidation strategies.

Investor Applicants play a vital role in the insolvency process by identifying and engaging prospective investors based on sector-specific interests and eligibility criteria. These agents send tailored invitations, pitch decks, and asset valuation insights to attract suitable investors. By coordinating investor queries, site visits, and virtual data room access, they facilitate a seamless interaction between investors and the distressed company, ensuring that all parties have the necessary information to make informed decisions.

Personal Guarantors play a significant role in the insolvency process, and AI-driven agents can assist in tracing these individuals, guiding them on their liabilities, and facilitating their representation. These agents enable secure communication channels for guarantors to receive updates on their obligations and engage with relevant stakeholders. They also facilitate disclosure filing and settlement proposals, ensuring that guarantors are aware of their options and can make informed decisions about their involvement in the insolvency process.
